title: Towards Enhancing Data Equity in Public Health Data Science

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the volume and proportional distribution of Electronic Health Records (EHR)-related research publications across geographic regions using Embase and MEDLINE databases, and comparing these proportions to global population distributions.

Analyzing the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog to measure the cumulative and proportional representation of different ancestral groups (e.g., European, African, Asian) in genome-wide association studies relative to estimated global population shares.

Evaluating and synthesizing literature on systematic measurement errors in pulse oximetry, specifically assessing how device accuracy degrades and leads to occult hypoxemia in patients with darker skin pigmentation.
